discord.step4: Send the bot a direct message, not in the server: on your phone, tap the bot in the server's member list, then Message. A question with a code appears here.

telegram.step3: On your phone, open the chat with your bot and press Start. A question with a code appears here.

slack.step3: Under Install App, install it to your workspace and copy the Bot User OAuth Token. It starts with xoxb-.
slack.step4: In Slack, open your app under Apps and write in its Messages tab. A question with a code appears here.

clone.aboutInOffice: Your name, what you do and what you look after are on the card colleagues see. Your clone starts every conversation knowing all of it.
clone.startOverHint: Moves what it keeps into a backup (nothing is deleted) and starts again from the first steps.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: How your clone does one kind of task your way. It opens one only when that kind of task comes up.
skills.none: No skills yet. When you show your clone how you want a kind of task done, it keeps it here.
skills.shareSure: These files go to your office, for colleagues' clones to add:
skills.officeHint: Skills your colleagues shared. Add one and your clone does that kind of task the way they do. Each is checked before it's added, and one you change is never replaced.
skills.officeNone: No one has shared a skill yet. Share one of yours above.
skills.scripts: {count, plural, one {a script} other {# scripts}}, which your clone never runs on its own
skills.changedHint: You changed it, so newer versions from the office don't replace it.
skills.taken: You have one by this name
skills.removeSure: Take it out of the office? Copies colleagues added stay theirs.

skill-creator.title: Make a skill
skill-creator.body: Keeps a way of working that comes back as a skill, so it's done your way next time.

learn-by-watching.title: Learn by watching
learn-by-watching.body: Learns a task the way you show it, or from a chat, an example or a document you point to.

browser.title: Use its browser
browser.body: Opens, reads, clicks and fills in pages in a browser of its own. Asks before paying, sending or agreeing.

artifact.title: Make documents and pages
artifact.body: Makes documents, sheets, charts and small pages as files that open in the app.

office.hereHint: It's open on this computer. Teammates on the same network join with the invite link.
office.joinedHint: Send the invite link to bring a colleague in.
office.leaveHint: Your clone leaves this office, and colleagues can't ask it anymore. You can come back with an invite link.

meetings.title: Meetings of the clones
meetings.hint: Your clone meets the others' at the standup, or when one asks everyone a question. It says what you worked on, found in your own records, and brings back only what matters to you.
meetings.takeHint: What it says goes to everyone in the office. Starting a meeting yourself turns this on.
meetings.dailyHint: For the whole office: on these days, at this time, the clones in the office meet once.

requests.notInOffice: Once you're in an office, colleagues' clones can ask yours for things. Here you choose what they can ask, and how much your clone does on its own.
requests.likeMeBody: Of the last {total} answers it showed you first, you sent {asIs} as they were.
requests.emptyMenu: Nothing listed yet. Let your clone draft what you usually take, or add one.

permissions.foldersHint: It reads only the ticked folders. One left out is never read or searched, in any AI tool's records.

general.languageHint: The screen's language, and the one your clone works in.
general.aboutBody: Clone Office gives everyone on a team a clone: an AI that works like them, does their everyday tasks, and stands in for them with teammates. It runs on your computer, and what it keeps stays here.
general.guide: Ask your clone how anything here works: it reads this app's guide to answer.
general.update: Version {version} is out. Close this one (Ctrl+C in its window), then start it again with:
general.startBody: Your clone keeps answering colleagues with no window open, from when you sign in.
general.startNone: Available when Clone Office runs from its package (npx clone-office).

preferences.autonomy: How much it does on its own
preferences.autonomyHint: In your own work: conversations with it and your flows.

ask.title: Ask me first
ask.body: Asks before it reads files, opens pages, runs commands or uses your services. Once you say “don't ask again” for something, it stops asking about it.

auto.title: On its own
auto.body: Reads, works in your connected services, runs commands in a safe closed-off space and asks colleagues without asking you first. All it does stays in the conversation.

preferences.always: Whatever you pick, files leaving your computer, flows, adding a skill, and work in your Claude Code or Codex conversations are always shown to you first. Colleagues' requests don't use this: each kind there has its own trust level, under Requests you take.
preferences.trust: New kinds of request start at
preferences.trustHint: Where a kind of request starts when you add it or your clone drafts it. Promises and decisions always come to you.
preferences.batchHint: While you're busy or away, questions about colleagues' requests wait and come together at {hours}.
preferences.reviewHint: It reads the conversation once more and keeps only what stays true about how you work. Off, it learns only what you tell it to remember.
preferences.lobbyHint: The first time you open the office each day, it starts at the building's lobby. Off, it opens straight at your desk.
preferences.lightHint: Looking back after a conversation, summaries and drafts run on a smaller model from the same service (Claude Haiku on your Claude subscription), using less of your plan or key. Your conversations, your flows and every answer to colleagues stay on the model you picked.
preferences.quietHint: Nothing goes to your phone in these hours; what waits is kept and comes when they end. Replies to what you write from your phone still come.

usage.title: Last 30 days
usage.hint: What your clone used its AI model for. No conversation text is kept for this.
usage.cost: About {cost} at API prices, as the model reports it. On a subscription nothing more is paid.

notices.title: In this browser
notices.body: A notice for each new thing that waits on you while this tab is not in view.
notices.blocked: This browser blocks notices from Clone Office; allow them in the browser's site settings.

requests.askHint: Your clone takes it to theirs. Files go only after you've seen them.

empty.bodyAlone: Requests travel between clones. Until a colleague joins, you can ask anyone by a link: they answer on a page, nothing to install.
